wire.voice.title: Voice mode
wire.voice.description: Talk to one conversation at a time with push-to-talk. That conversation's own agent answers, and its last reply is read aloud. Read on the next spoken reply.
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.label: longest spoken reply
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.help: Replies longer than this many characters are cut at a sentence and end with "The rest is on screen." Code blocks and links are never read aloud.
wire.voice.not_enabled: Voice mode is not on for this conversation. Turn it on for this conversation first.
wire.voice.unknown_session: There is no conversation with id {session_id}.
wire.voice.unknown_source: There is nothing to read aloud for that reference.
wire.voice.stt_unavailable: This device cannot transcribe speech: {reason} Type the message instead.
wire.voice.invalid_request: Send exactly one of a recording or a text message, not both and not neither.
wire.voice.unsupported_audio: That recording format is not supported. Use WAV, WebM, Ogg or MP4.
wire.voice.upload_too_large: That recording is too large. Keep it under {limit_mib} MiB.
wire.voice.empty_transcript: Nothing was heard in that recording, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.store_busy: Something else on this device is changing voice mode. Try again in a moment.
wire.voice.invalid_request_id: The request id must be a dashed UUID, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.approval_pending: Answer the question or approval on screen first.
wire.voice.local_stt_url.label: local transcription server
wire.voice.local_stt_url.help: An OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server on this machine, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000. Empty turns it off.
wire.voice.front_end.label: listening front end
wire.voice.front_end.help: What hears a push-to-talk take before it is sent. Local uses this device's transcription; Gemini Live sends your speech to Google.
wire.voice.front_end.choice.local.label: local
wire.voice.front_end.choice.local.descri: Transcribe on this device or through your speech provider.
Google's live audio model hears the take and passes your words on.
wire.voice.front_end_unavailable: That listening front end is not available here: {reason}
wire.voice.live_failed: Gemini Live could not start a session: {reason}
wire.voice.front_end.local_available: Push-to-talk transcription runs through this device's speech path.
wire.voice.front_end.live_no_key: No Google AI Studio key is stored. Sign in with lop login google.
wire.voice.front_end.live_available: A Google AI Studio key is stored.
wire.voice.phrase.on_screen_first: Answer the approval on screen first.
wire.voice.phrase.switched: Voice is now on this conversation.
wire.voice.phrase.nothing_to_repeat: There is nothing to repeat yet.
wire.voice.invalid_text_origin: text_origin names where a front end's words came from: gemini_live_transcript or gemini_live_tool_arg, with text and no recording.
wire.voice.live_main_only: Live tokens are issued to the desktop app itself, not to a web page.
